prompt.alinti: OmniCloud is a free tool that lets you manage files from Google Drive, Dropbox, and more in one place.
It's a self-hosted dashboard that connects to seven cloud providers, including OneDrive, Mega, and S3-compatible storage.
You get a unified file explorer with views for recent, starred, and shared files.
Uploads show real-time progress, and you can rename, delete, or star files across all accounts from one screen.
You install it locally or with Docker, connect each cloud account through OAuth or login credentials, and then browse everything from a single interface.
It's perfect if you're tired of switching between multiple cloud apps.
It's a free, open-source alternative to services like MultCloud.
Comment cloud, and I'll send you the repo link.

yontem.ne: Birden fazla bulut sağlayıcısını tek bir arayüzle birleştirir.
yontem.alinti: OmniCloud is a full-stack cloud drive aggregation platform that presents multiple storage providers through a single, consistent workspace.

yontem.ne: Çeşitli bulut depolama hesaplarını tek bir uygulamada birleştirir.
Hesaplar OAuth, hesap tabanlı giriş veya erişim anahtarlarıyla bağlanır.
yontem.alinti: Active providers support includes OAuth, account-based login, and access-key based connections

yontem.ne: Tüm sağlayıcılar bir uyumlu adapter katmanıyla eşleştirilir.

akis.ne: GitHub deposunu gösterir ve `github.com/dimartarmizi/OmniCloud` adresini paylaşır.

OmniCloud'un teknolojik bileşenlerini listeler: Vue.js, TailwindCSS, Node.js, Express.js, SQLite, WebSocket.
